payloadTruncatedWarning: Truncated or non-JSON payload — raw display.
alertsTriggeredTooltip: {n} alert(s) triggered on the host within 15 min of this deployment
detectedPathTooltip: Path detected from the host's Compose projects
currentTasksYamlSuffix: on the host — add the task below:
taskToAddInSection: Task to add in the tasks: section:
newReleaseTagDesc: Tag of the new release (e.g. v1.2.3)
regenerateSecretConfirmMessage: The old secret will be invalidated immediately. You will need to update the configuration in your Git provider.
autoUpdateExplanation: Update detection is now automatic for every container (version badge in the Docker tab): this list is only for additionally enabling automatic update. Compose-managed containers with no tracker: a Docker tracker in Compose mode will be created for each one (automatic pull + up -d on every new image).
noContainersToTrackSubtitle: Every detected compose container already has a tracker, or none has been collected.
couldNotLoadContainersError: Unable to load the detected containers.
gitReleaseDescription: Watches for new releases/tags on GitHub, GitLab or Gitea
dockerImageDescription: Detects when a new image is pushed to the registry
hostRunningContainerHint: Host the tracked container runs on.
imageTagDeducedFromContainerHint: The watched image and tag are derived from the chosen container.
registryCredentialsHint: Credentials to query an image on a private registry (GHCR, Harbor…).
linkedRepoInfoHint: Purely informational: the repo's release notes are shown alongside the digest history. Update detection still relies on the Docker registry.
imageVersionResolvedDesc: Exact version resolved from the digest (e.g. 4.4.1), or identical to SS_IMAGE_TAG if not resolved
cooldownRangeError: Cooldown must be between 0 and 168 hours.
gitOwnerRepoRequiredError: Owner and repo are required for a Git tracker.
dispatchTaskRequiredError: Target VM and task ID are required when task dispatch is enabled.
linkedRepoBothFieldsError: For the linked Git repo, fill in owner and repo together (or leave both empty).
composeModeRequiredError: Target VM and compose project are required in Compose mode.
webhookRequiredFieldsError: Name, target VM and task ID are required.
monitorOnlyHint: If disabled, the tracker only monitors and records the version without running a script.
cooldownDelayHint: Delay before triggering after a new version is detected (0 = immediate).
composeNativeDescription: automatic pull + up -d on a compose project, no script
customTaskModeDescription: Runs a script declared on the agent side
composeProjectHint: Compose project name as discovered on the host (label {label}).
healthcheckHint: Max wait for the healthy state after up -d (0 = disabled).
driftExplanationHint: Drift: the actually deployed container no longer matches the tracked version (manual change, silent failure...). Checked: automatically re-triggers pull + up -d. Unchecked: drift is only flagged on the tracker.
preUpdateHookHint: Task {code} run before the pull (e.g. backup).
enableChannelHint: Enable at least one channel to be notified of new versions.
